reference_policy: Photos: hair, clothing and expressive energy only, never likeness. Dollhouse screenshots: ensemble readability and modularity only, not faces, assets, palette, layout or UI.

prompts.name: cast-a
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished ORIGINAL ZipperCrew 2D character design sheet, landscape 1536x1024. Title "A · Quiet Ensemble". Warm off-white neutral background. This is FLAT 2D illustration for an adult miniature-world productivity tool: opaque flat color shapes, fine dark outline, just one small hard-edged shadow tone, NO gradients, NO highlights, NO 3D/sculpted rendering. Simplified hands/shoes, bold silhouettes, graphic faces with expressive eyebrows, adult youthful proportions about 4 heads tall, not babies. Top half: large full-body lineup labeled Human, Implementer, Reviewer. Human: original young male creative orchestrator, dark copper irregular curly hair with an asymmetric lifted tuft, warm amused face, plum open overshirt over ochre shirt with one turquoise cuff, slate cropped trousers, simple contrasting shoes, mustard notebook as a score. Curious listening posture, not managerial. Reference photos are HAIR/CLOTHING/EXPRESSIVE ENERGY inspiration only, not a face or likeness. Implementer: orange/coral artificial persona, broad bean-shaped torso, small cream horizontal face panel and confident graphic eyes, one off-center fin, large simple hands, grounded stance, enthusiastic maker. Reviewer: taller narrow teal artificial persona, slanted head edge, two horizontal graphic eyes and one skeptical raised brow, long clean tabard-like body, tucked rectangular review pad, deliberate posture. Agents clearly nonhuman and different shapes; not detailed mechanical robots. Bottom half: four equally sized full-body poses of SAME Human, labeled Neutral, Orchestrating, At laptop, Expressive idle. Respectively standing attentive, palm giving gentle direction, seated at simple laptop on small table, head tilted listening with notebook and expressive free hand. Four clearly separate cells, no overlap. Small black silhouette strip of trio bottom-right if space. Calm elegant disciplined illustration, contemporary, warm but not cute babyish, enough personality for repeated use. Do not copy any existing game characters, Toca faces/proportions/assets/palette or Jacob Collier face; do not resemble any celebrity. No furniture except laptop pose, no marketing copy.

prompts.name: cast-b
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce landscape 1536x1024 original ZipperCrew FLAT 2D illustrated cast exploration sheet. Title in small sans serif: "B · Offbeat Ensemble". Neutral pale ivory background. Two rows: TOP full-body trio labeled Human / Implementer / Reviewer; BOTTOM the same Human four poses labeled Neutral / Orchestrating / At laptop / Expressive idle. Bottom corner three small SOLID BLACK silhouettes. IMPORTANT visual medium: flat graphic ink-and-opaque-color character art, NO gradient shading, NO sculpted volume, NO glossy materials, NO painterly texture. Broad clean color areas, sparse dark outlines, only occasional flat shadow under sleeve. Shapes should still have warmth and life. Simplified mitten hands with one thumb, single-shape shoes, stylized adults about 3.5 heads tall with shoulders and confident longish stance, not baby/chibi. Original faces using asymmetric eyebrows, small wedge noses, curved warm smiles and narrow oval eyes, not any existing game's face style.
Human is a youthful male CREATIVE ORCHESTRATOR, not manager: oversized asymmetric dark-auburn hair silhouette made of FIVE interlocking curling lobes, one wayward high curl, no individual hair strands. Slim slightly leaning body, expressive hands, head tilted listening, amused 'I have an idea' expression. Layered PLUM short open jacket with lilac contrasting cuff and coral patch over ochre shirt, relaxed dark tapered trousers, cream slip-ons with one coral sole. A compact yellow notebook with graphic colored index tabs is his score. No music notation. Distinct original face, not a portrait or celebrity likeness. Four bottom poses show listening-neutral; notebook held open in one hand and other hand conducting toward an agent; seated side-threequarter working at laptop; playful sideways lean nodding with a raised finger.
Implementer is a CORAL artificial companion, not normal person: broad compact trapezoidal body, offset half-circle ear/headphone on only one side, rounded wide head with pale face panel and energetic brows, TWO short prong crest, sturdy boots and big clean mitten hands, reaching ready to build. Simple few parts, no segmented robotic joints. Reviewer is TEAL artificial companion: taller inverted-droplet head with square lower edge, narrow tapered body, sharply angled brow and calm half-lidded eyes, flat cream review tablet tucked under one arm, other hand making precise annotation gesture; elegant rather than grumpy. Different silhouettes beyond color. Cohesive original warm adult-friendly dollhouse game cast. No Toca character proportions/faces, no existing franchise, no 3D render, no fashion-illustration anatomy.

prompts.name: cast-c
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL ZipperCrew cast concept board "C · Little Signals". Landscape 1536x1024, neutral offwhite. This is STRICTLY FLAT 2D GRAPHIC GAME ILLUSTRATION, like carefully authored opaque-color animation cels. ABSOLUTELY NO gradients, shading, light falloff, glossy modeling, bevels, anime eyes, sculpted hair, fine linework or realistic fingers. Each garment or hair mass is one SOLID color. Sparse thick ink outlines and flat inset face shapes. Very elegant editorial graphic playfulness for an adult productivity tool. NOT Toca imitation, NOT any existing franchise's characters or faces, NOT toy blocks or babies.
Layout: upper 55% shows full-body trio, same approximate total height; labeled Human / Implementer / Reviewer. Lower45% four equal Human pose cells, labeled Neutral / Orchestrating / At laptop / Expressive idle. Tiny black silhouette strip of trio at bottom right.
Character construction: each approximately 3 head heights, adult long nose/chin and defined shoulders, compact body with clear feet. Large expressive head but NOT chibi infant. Human: young male creative orchestrator, offbeat and warm. WIDE ASYMMETRIC AUBURN HAIR silhouette made of just FOUR HUGE WAVY LOBES, one tall curled hook. Graphic face: long wedge nose, small dark bean-shaped eyes, asymmetrical thick eyebrows and a crooked amused smile, curious listening head tilt. Plum loose collarless overshirt with one lavender sleeve cuff and one coral pocket, mustard shirt, roomy indigo trousers, oversized simple cream shoes with a single coral stripe. Simplify outfit to 6 flat patches total. Small ochre notebook with three bright index tabs, no text/music. His silhouette and gesture communicate eclectic creative-musician ENERGY, never a celebrity face or likeness. Neutral holds book with raised curious eyebrow; Orchestrating opens book and gestures as a conductor; At laptop seated on plain stool typing at small table, attentive; Expressive idle leans sideways listening, one shoe lifted slightly, notebook under arm.
Implementer: ORIGINAL SHORT BROAD CORAL AGENT, body one rounded pentagon with short legs, face a WIDE HORIZONTAL cream display inset in upper body, dark lively dash eyes, offcenter double antenna shaped like two short leaf blades, one side ear disc. Oversize coral mitten hands, yellow apron-like central patch, solid dark feet; lively eager stance. NO robot joints/armor detail.
Reviewer: ORIGINAL TALLER TEAL AGENT, asymmetric lozenge head tilted gently, cream face with long single straight eyebrow and two small level eyes, narrow tapered tunic-like body and flat feet, holding rectangular review pad with ONE bold check stroke. Hands simple. Upright calm analytical. Distinct outline from maker.
Same sophistication and mark-making across all three. Flat sprites that remain recognizable at 90px tall, strong silhouettes, beautiful negative space. Keep the Human emotionally central. No environment, only the laptop/table in that one pose.

prompts.name: room-01-three
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. New ZipperCrew world concept "01 · Window Lane". WIDE landscape 1536x1024. Attached sheet defines the EXACT C · Little Signals trio; maintain those designs, flat shapes, plum Human wild auburn 4-lobed hair and notebook, broad coral maker, tall teal diamond-headed reviewer. Show these EXACT THREE participants, no extra people. A clean FLAT 2D ILLUSTRATED dollhouse workspace café for adults, NOT a 3D render, not isometric. Frontal wall with shallow floor strip, sparse dark outlines, matte flat opaque colors, no dimensional lighting or decorative gradients. Similar graphic simplification to characters.
Compose one horizontal inhabited stage: asymmetric long daylight window along upper left, off-center SMALL shared brief on far right wall rather than central classroom board. Compact coffee shelf/cabinet at far left with just a machine and two cups. Human informal stool with small laptop perch left foreground; maker tidy light workstation center; reviewer smaller reading nook right, angled inward. No desks lined up like a class: maker works at side-facing screen, reviewer sits with pad at little round side table, Human stands gesturing between. Clear open walking strip in front. No carpet, no potted jungle, no string lights, no wall décor, no photoreal wood grain, no chalkboard. Quiet light cream wall, pale mineral-blue floor, warm wood table edges, dark slender furniture legs. Characters are most colorful, prominent at least 240px tall.
Show maker visibly typing, reviewer reading pad, Human leaning toward maker offering notebook guidance. A small local activity bubble above maker: "Running tests…" and smaller "14 passed". ONE physical cream document with CORAL edge floats toward reviewer, labeled "Proposal"; use short dotted arc and separate paper silhouette, no bubble tail. This is a conceptual communication example, not a live trace. A tiny two-item legend at bottom: bubble symbol "Local activity"; paper symbol "Protocol message". Two plain small state labels near feet: "Working" and "Reviewing". Board reads "Shared brief" with two short graphic lines. Friendly warm calm original inhabited room, no dashboard card framing, no app menus. Modularity visible in two subtle window-bay joints. Crisp sophisticated game illustration, no franchise imitation.

prompts.name: room-02-three
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original ZipperCrew room direction "02 · Linked Studios — 3 participants", landscape 1536x1024. Reference image is CAST IDENTITY ONLY: use its exact C · Little Signals Human, coral Implementer, teal Reviewer in flat illustrated technique. Produce a clean 2D dollhouse miniature-world room, front wall elevation with just a SHALLOW floor, flat graphic color and sparse outlines, no 3D perspective rendering, no volumetric lighting. No gradients/textures. All three figures LARGE and recognizable, not miniature icons. Only 3 characters.
A modular studio divided into two offset shallow alcoves connected by a broad OPEN ARCH; continuous floor path visible in foreground. Left broader alcove: low wide window, compact coffee machine/counter at outside left wall, Human's informal round laptop perch near coffee, one thin worktable for CORAL maker closer to the open arch. Right narrower alcove: TEAL reviewer's quiet angled reading perch with tablet and one tiny side table, plain pinned shared brief wall-sheet on outer right wall. Human stands foreground at the seam listening, holding yellow notebook and giving a gentle directing gesture. Keep asymmetry, distinct positions and readable walking space. No rows of desks, no classroom, no rug, no plants/decor, no extra chairs, no slogans. Architecture light chalk neutral, quiet apricot arch edge, pale blue-grey floor, warm solid wood accents; characters carry all strong colors.
Show Human just giving direction; maker sits typing at LAPTOP facing inward; reviewer stands checking tablet. A small outlined LOCAL speech bubble attached only to maker reads "Running tests…" with smaller "14 passed". A PHYSICAL paper card with teal edge labeled "Review · #17" travels from Reviewer toward Human on one clean dotted arc, visibly separate from bubble, small light cream card. Human subtle plum attention mark. Tiny bottom legend "Bubble: local activity     Card: protocol communication". Conceptual illustrative events, not a running product screenshot. No huge empty space, no dashboard surround. Small header only at top margin. The empty architectural joint on right edge suggests another bay can attach, not a blank room. Emphasize mature graphic game system and charming cast, no franchise faces/layout/assets.

prompts.name: room-02-five
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ZipperCrew scale test "02 · Linked Studios — 5 participants". Landscape 2048x1024. Reference 1 is SAME room language to extend, Reference 2 exact C · Little Signals cast. Produce NEW wider edition of linked 2D illustrated dollhouse studios. Flat opaque illustrated forms, graphic faces, no 3D rendering. Preserve original Human + coral maker + teal reviewer designs. Exactly FIVE characters, count carefully, no reflections/extra people.
Two connected shallow bays and wide open passage, continuous foreground walking lane. Left social/work bay: compact coffee counter, window, Human informal notebook perch and maker laptop. Right review/research bay: two small offset reading perches and reference shelf with just two books. Clean quiet architecture, no carpet, clutter, logos, slogans, babyish decorations. Characters remain LARGE, 280–350px tall, face/props unmistakable.
Five characters left-to-right, small readable name and state labels near feet:
1 "Human · Observing": only HUMAN, wild auburn 4-lobed hair, plum jacket, yellow score notebook, standing attentive and listening in center-left passage.
2 "Implementer · Working": original broad coral maker with paired yellow antenna and side earcap, seated typing at laptop, happy focused face.
3 "Reviewer 1 · Reviewing": original tall teal diamond head and straight brow, holding pad and annotating.
4 "Reviewer 2 · Waiting": teal sibling with broader angled head and ONE short antenna, tiny number 2 chest patch, seated with coffee; clearly distinct silhouette from Reviewer1.
5 "Researcher · Reading": compact slate-blue artificial companion with wide rounded-square head, flat cream face and folded map/reference pages, small square earcaps, inspecting two-page book. No human anatomy, consistent graphic family.
Name labels match actual locations even if physical order changes. Only one LOCAL speech bubble, attached to maker: "Running tests…" / "14 passed". One coral-edged DOCUMENT called "Proposal · #17" branches into two separate paper copies on short dotted routes to Reviewer1 and Reviewer2. Keep physical cards distinct from speech bubble and do not cover faces. This is a future multi-role layout study, no implied current implementation. Header small, preserve space for scene. Quiet cream wall, apricot arch, mineral blue floor, light wood tabletops, saturated cast accents. Right edge architectural joint indicates modular extension. All five together easy to identify without tiny avatars.
